cases.contractRef: G002 acceptance b: no duplicate delivery
cases.scenario: Identical assistant message_end, including message id, appears twice on the owned stream.
cases.expectedBehavior: Both callbacks may run; deterministic interim id makes the second ledger prepare a no-op.
cases.testName: RT01 duplicate message_end reaches callback twice but deterministic ledger permits one delivery
cases.notes: Real TailRunner + DeliveryService + SQLite ledger. Two callbacks, one inflight delivery row. Mirrors server.ts deterministic prepare path; not a socket-level server test.

cases.contractRef: G002 design: foreign commandId/turnId frames are dropped
cases.scenario: Both ids differ, commandId alone differs, turnId alone differs, and uncorrelated assistant speech; then uncorrelated idle.
cases.expectedBehavior: All foreign/uncorrelated speech is dropped; idle and correctly correlated sentinel survive.
cases.testName: RT02 every contradictory correlation is dropped; only uncorrelated idle survives
cases.notes: Frozen source accepts same commandId with a contradictory turnId. tail-runner.ts #matchesTurn returns on commandId before checking turnId. Expected [activity,sentinel], actual [turn wrong,activity,sentinel]. Failing assertion retained; parent informed.

cases.scenario: An older correlated agent_end is consumed before the new turn accept receipt.
cases.expectedBehavior: Document adoption of stale end; real receipt replaces both ids and subsequent real speech remains observable.
cases.testName: RT03 stale pre-receipt agent_end is adopted but receipt replaces both correlation ids
cases.notes: Stale end is indeed adopted and delivered as idle. correlate overwrites both ids, so real frames are not dropped. This test does not prove stale terminal actor side effects harmless.

cases.contractRef: G002 design: reconcile uncertain send before retry
cases.scenario: Relay closes before control_response; actor sees unknown, accepted, or in_flight status; unknown later proves live and queue-empty.
cases.expectedBehavior: RelayClosedError; send then status, never blind resend; accepted/in_flight adopt; unknown initially holds and releases only with subsequent affirmative live-idle evidence.
cases.testName: RT04 relay death rejects in-flight send before receipt; RT04 actor reconciles unknown/accepted/in_flight before any resend after torn send; RT04 unknown bound operation releases only after a second status sweep proves live idle
cases.notes: Real BrokerSessionPort transport rejection plus ScriptedSessionPort actor state-machine cases. Exact same-operation status ordering checked.

cases.contractRef: G002 acceptance b; design: relay loss reconciliation
cases.scenario: Relay disappears after one interim message; durable original result later becomes terminal.
cases.expectedBehavior: recovery_hold reason=relay_lost_mid_turn, one original-output read and one terminal callback, no interim replay or resend.
cases.testName: RT05 relay loss after interim settles original output once without replaying interim
cases.notes: Real PersonaSessionManager with scripted port; repeated reconcile checked.

cases.contractRef: G002 design: uncertain query never releases accepted work
cases.scenario: Owned turn.result never answers; actor reconciliation invokes real BrokerSessionPort status with that relay.
cases.expectedBehavior: RelayRequestTimeoutError and status_unavailable hold; accepted state retained without release/requeue.
cases.testName: RT06 status query timeout keeps actor accepted and held
cases.notes: 5 ms actual relay timer, not a fabricated timeout error. Actor port bridge records relay supplied by actor.

cases.contractRef: G002 design: bounded busy wait uses same clientRef
cases.scenario: Two busy refusals then acceptance, or perpetual busy through 4000 ms virtual deadline.
cases.expectedBehavior: Three attempts with identical clientRef; exactly one acceptance or none on deadline failure.
cases.testName: RT07 busy retries retain clientRef; accepts=true; RT07 busy retries retain clientRef; accepts=false
cases.notes: Real BrokerSessionPort controls and injectable clock/sleep; no real two-second sleeps.

cases.scenario: Owned control returns client_ref_conflict and actor dispatch encounters the typed rejection.
cases.expectedBehavior: OpRefRejectedError with conflict code; actor logs recovery_client_ref_conflict, queries status once, never resends.
cases.testName: RT08 client_ref_conflict is typed and actor queries status without resending
cases.notes: Real transport error mapping and independent scripted actor recovery.

cases.contractRef: G002 design: owned steering and held replay
cases.scenario: Steer uses live owned relay; ambiguous actor steer remains held until terminal then replays.
cases.expectedBehavior: Owned connectionId is stamped and handle remains open; same clientRef replays without old owned relay after terminal.
cases.testName: RT09 steer uses owned connection and held steer replay retains clientRef without owned relay
cases.notes: Real wire stamp checked. Actor replay uses ScriptedSessionPort: proves absent relay argument, not a separately spawned real throwaway relay process.

cases.scenario: maxTailProcesses=1 while first handle is turn-running; retired and current second attaches.
cases.expectedBehavior: Retired gets TailCapacityError; current remains pending then attaches after first closes.
cases.testName: RT10 retired capacity refuses while current attach waits for running owner to close
cases.notes: Real TailRunner, two scripted hosts and actual close/release.

cases.scenario: Malformed JSON and a >256 KiB unknown frame precede valid assistant speech.
cases.expectedBehavior: Handle remains open and valid later message delivers.
cases.testName: RT11 malformed and oversized stdout lines do not prevent later frames
cases.notes: Tests supplied line transport resilience; does not exercise subprocess byte-to-line splitting or assert memory bounds.

cases.scenario: Stream ends after hello request without answering; another pre-hello handle is evicted for capacity.
cases.expectedBehavior: First attach rejects missing hello; closed pre-ready handle rejects readiness without waiting 15 seconds.
cases.testName: RT12 stream ends without hello and pre-hello eviction both reject readiness
cases.notes: No 15-second timer wait. Pending rejection captured with .then before eviction to avoid Bun matcher blocking setup.

cases.contractRef: G002 acceptance b: ordered stream delivery
cases.scenario: Fifty synchronous message_end frames and an asynchronous consumer sleeping on every third frame.
cases.expectedBehavior: Callbacks complete in exact numerical order 0..49.
cases.testName: RT13 fifty synchronous frames preserve order through a slow asynchronous consumer

cases.contractRef: G002 design: work-lane observer failure fallback
cases.scenario: WorkLaneManager attachTail throws; accepted operation later obtains terminal original output via status.
cases.expectedBehavior: Start succeeds, exactly one send with no relay, later settlement reads original output once.
cases.testName: RT14 work start survives observer spawn failure, sends once without relay and settles by status
cases.notes: Real WorkLaneManager and LaneGovernor with ScriptedSessionPort; proves fallback call shape and status settlement, not OS subprocess creation.
